In the current study, to improve the calculating efficiency, section image registration and alignment were implemented using the bilinear method13. Figure 2 displays results of registration of five section images randomly selected from the median nerve of the cubital fossa region. As it can be seen in the images after registration, the position lines were corrected to the same coordinate position of section images.
